title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
abstract: arXiv:2611.17766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic workplace requests written by professionals in 13 domains, each paired with an expert rubric of binary criteria and with the complete workbook or CSV file it refers to. Together the files hold 2.18 million populated cells, and the rubrics 791 criteria. Agents work in a container with spreadsheet tools, and an agentic judge that can open the file applies the rubric. Completeness and exclusivity criteria require set-valued answers to be found in full and with nothing extra. We rank models by strict pass@1, the share of attempts that meet every criterion. Across 20 model configurations, including frontier models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, the top-scoring one, Gemini 4 Argon, passes only 38.3% of attempts, and the median score is 19.3%, leaving wide headroom. translated_title: GDP.xlsx：基于专业工作簿的前沿模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们推出了GDP_xlsx基准，包含70个由13个领域的专业人士撰写的真实职场请求，每个请求都配有专家制定的二元评分标准，以及其所指向的完整工作簿或CSV文件。这些文件共包含218万个已填充单元格，评分标准包含791项准则。智能体在配备电子表格工具的容器中工作，由一个能够打开文件的智能体裁判来应用评分标准。完整性和排他性准则要求集合型答案必须完整找出且没有多余内容。我们采用严格的pass@1指标对模型进行排名，即满足所有准则的尝试占比。在包括来自Google、Anthropic和OpenAI的前沿模型在内的20个模型配置中，得分最高的Gemini 4 Argon也只有38.3%的尝试通过，中位数得分为19.3%，留下了很大的提升空间。我们发布了评估框架和三个公开任务；其余67个任务被保留，以保护排行榜免受污染。
tldr: 该论文提出GDP_xlsx基准，利用13个领域专业人士撰写的70个真实工作簿任务和791项专家评分准则来评估前沿AI模型的电子表格处理能力，发现最强模型Gemini 4 Argon的通过率也仅有38.3%，表明该领域仍有巨大的提升空间。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic professional workbook tasks with 791 expert rubric criteria across 13 domains, showing that even the best frontier model (Gemini 4 Argon) passes only 38.3% of attempts, revealing substantial headroom for improvement.
